notes:
Account snapshot: mid-market product org building an in-app assistant + developer tooling. Initially attracted to Redwood hosted API for quick time-to-market; strong interest in moving to Dedicated once throughput predictable and SLA established. 

Key asks from last demo: 
- P95 latency target: <=250ms for chat context up to 1024 tokens (goal).
- Sustained throughput: ~120 qps for user-facing assistant; batch re-ranking job peaks ~350 rps during nightly syncs.
- Cost sensitivity: internal target to reduce inference unit cost by ~50-70% vs current cloud GPU per-token spend. Budgeting exercise required.

POC plan: 
- Phase 1 (hosted API): baseline perf + cost for Llama-2-13B (fp16) and a 7B quantized variant. Capture token-level billing and latency percentiles.
- Phase 2 (dedicated eval): run same load on a small dedicated pool, enable autoscaling, test canary fallback to quantized variant under pressure.
- Phase 3 (optimize workshop): 2-hr working session with Marco and RD engineering to tune batching, KV prefix caching, and try two quantization profiles (4-bit and 8-bit) and measure unit economics.

Notes from last call (Rhea): "If we can get predictable 60% cost savings and maintain NPS for assistant, we can commit to a 12-month Dedicated contract." SE comment: "Need to nail caching strategy for chat state to hit latency targets without sacrificing token savings."

Security/compliance: SOC2 in place; legal requests data residency clause for EU customers (some EU customers likely). Need SSO/SAML and KMS integration for key management. Audit log retention requirements: 1 year for debug logs, 7 years for security events (legal wants options).

Decision factors: unit-cost models, predictable SLAs for Dedicated, ability to hybrid route (hosted -> dedicated fallback), clear demo artifacts showing batch-size vs latency tradeoffs, and firm pricing for mixed-tier usage.

POC metrics we will collect: cost/token, tokens/sec, P50/P95 latency, cache hit rate, quantization-quality delta (perplexity/QA accuracy on eval prompts).
